## Visual & Layout Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK001 Are the logical screen resolution (`160×144` pixels, `20×18` tiles of `8×8` pixels) and 4-shade color palette values explicitly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are the Title Screen visual elements (`TETRIS™` logo, St. Basil's Cathedral silhouette, `1 PLAYER / 2 PLAYER` labels, `©1989 Nintendo` footer) completely defined against `screenshot_00.png`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Are the distinct `8×8` tile visual patterns specified for all 7 tetromino types (`T`, `L`, `J`, `I`, `S`, `Z`, `O`) to match `screenshot_01.png`–`screenshot_13.png`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are the dimensions and placement of the playable well (`10` columns × `18` visible rows + `2` hidden top rows), brick borders, and right-hand HUD (`SCORE`, `LEVEL`, `LINES`, `NEXT`) unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Core Gameplay Mechanics & Scoring Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are the rotation states (4 orientations for `L`, `J`, `T`; 2 for `I`, `Z`, `S`; 1 for `O`) and wall/stack rotation rejection rules (no wall kicks) clearly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK006 Is the gravity speed table quantified in frames per row drop across all levels (`0` through `20`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK007 Are Delayed Auto-Shift (DAS: 23-frame initial delay, 9-frame repeat) and soft-drop timing (1 row per 3 frames) quantified with exact frame counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK008 Are both the line-clear scoring formula (`40/100/300/1200 × (level + 1)`) and soft-drop point calculation (`+1` point per continuous soft-dropped row upon lock) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]

## Game Modes, Edge Cases & Progression Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Is the Type A level transition threshold (`(startLevel + 1) × 10` lines for first transition, then every 10 lines up to Level 20) unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Are Type B initial garbage row counts (`0, 3, 5, 8, 10, 12` rows for Heights `0`–`5`) and the incomplete-row constraint (at least 1 empty cell per row) specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK011 Is the boundary behavior specified when clearing lines in Type B would reduce `LINES` below `0` (clamping `LINES` to `0` while awarding full line points)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are the Pause anti-cheat masking requirement (hiding well tiles and `NEXT` piece while paused) and `SELECT` preview toggle specified? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Are Top-3 High Score storage, scoping per Game Type/Level/Height, and 3-character initials entry requirements defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-014]

## Controls & Audio Requirements Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Are both the `tetris_gb_reviews.xml` keymap (`1`, `Alt`, `Ctrl`, `Arrow Keys`) and standard PC keymap (`Enter`, `Z`, `X`, `Up`, `Arrow Keys`, `Shift`/`Backspace`, `P`/`Escape`, `M`) consistently defined without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK015 Is browser default behavior suppression (`preventDefault()` on `Alt`, `Ctrl`, `Arrow Keys`) specified to prevent focus loss and scrolling? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK016 Are all four Music Type options (`A-TYPE`, `B-TYPE`, `C-TYPE`, `OFF`) and gameplay sound effect cues specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-013]
